about: Synthesized sound effects (rendered locally by scripts/render/audio.py from code; nothing is downloaded). A menu of starting points, never a fence: an effect not listed here is always allowed as {"invented": "<name>", "why": "...", "recipe": [layers]} and is judged only by outcome (audible over the bed, no clipping, loudness).
how_to_choose: One effect per visual event that MEANS something (a reveal, a count, a failure, a section change). Never decoration.
Sound is OFF by default; it is switched on by storyboard.audio or design_system.audio.
Keep effects sparse: at most one every ~2 s of narration, and never on top of the key word of a line unless it is the hit itself.
gain_db is the effect's RMS relative to the narration's active level; the mix measures and reports real audibility against the bed.

invented_form.why: <what visual event it marks and why no listed effect fits>

kinds.tone: sine sweeping f0 -> f1 (exponential), exp(-decay*t) envelope
kinds.noise: seeded white noise through lp|hp|bp at freq/q, exp(-decay*t) envelope

effects.label: UI click
use_when: a button, toggle or selection on screen
a small state change
effects.character: short bright tick with a noisy edge

effects.label: clock tick
use_when: waiting, polling, a timer counting
a step in a fast sequence
effects.character: narrow band noise click, very short

effects.label: pop
use_when: a node, card or label appears
an item is added to a list

effects.label: whoosh
use_when: a camera move or a panel sliding in
something travels from A to B
effects.character: band-pass noise sweep up and down

effects.label: ding
use_when: a result arrives
a check passes
the end of a worked example

effects.label: rising chime
use_when: an idea clicks into place
a reveal of the answer

effects.label: error buzz
use_when: a failure, a rejected request, a wrong path

effects.label: stamp
use_when: a verdict or decision is recorded
an approval or a label is applied

effects.label: page turn
use_when: a document or record is opened
a new section of a file

effects.label: typing
use_when: code or text is being written on screen
a log streams

effects.label: question
use_when: a question is posed
an unknown or an open item

effects.label: riser
use_when: the build-up into a hit or a key reveal (place it to END on the hit)
effects.character: noise and tone rising for two seconds, cut just before the end

effects.label: impact
use_when: the hit itself: the key word lands
a big number appears
effects.character: low falling sine with a rumble tail

effects.label: section card
use_when: a section title appears
a change of chapter
effects.character: short low thump with a high glint

effects.label: rewind
use_when: going back to an earlier step
a replay or undo

effects.label: glass clink
use_when: two things meet or match
a small success in a series
effects.character: high inharmonic partials, very fast decay
